name: SCROPHULARIA NODOSA
key_symptoms: Vertigo felt in vertex, greater when standing; drowsiness; pain from forehead to back of head. Eczema behind ear. Crusta lactea.
Violent dyspnśa, oppression of chest with trembling. Pain about bifurcation of trachea. Asthma in scrofulous patients.
guiding_symptoms: Vertigo felt in vertex, greater when standing; drowsiness; pain from forehead to back of head. Eczema behind ear. Crusta lactea.

head_symptoms: Vertigo felt in vertex, greater when standing; drowsiness; pain from forehead to back of head. Eczema behind ear. Crusta lactea.
respiratory_symptoms: Violent dyspnśa, oppression of chest with trembling. Pain about bifurcation of trachea. Asthma in scrofulous patients.
gi_symptoms: Pain in liver on pressure. Colic below navel. Pain in sigmoid flexure and rectum. Painful, bleeding, protruding piles.
skin_symptoms: Prickling itching, worse back of hand.
sleep_symptoms: Great drowsiness; in morning and before and after meals with weariness.
